requirements.title: IDispatcher Interface Definition
requirements.detail: Interface includes extra method `lookup_async` not listed in spec. All spec-required methods are present.

requirements.title: DispatcherError Type
requirements.detail: All failure modes covered: NotInitialized, KeyNotFound, AlreadyExists, AllocationFailed, IoError, Timeout, InvalidParameter.

requirements.title: populate(key, ipc_handle)
requirements.detail: Implementation calls evict_for_space, mt.insert, gpu.dma_copy_to_host, dm.create_memory_tier_entry, enqueues background write.

requirements.title: Background Write-Through
requirements.detail: process_write_job reads from memory-tier pointer, writes to SSD, calls dm.convert_to_storage on success.

requirements.title: Memory-Tier Retention After Write-Through
requirements.detail: Write-through does not free the memory-tier slot. Entry remains for fast lookups.

requirements.title: lookup Dispatch Logic
requirements.detail: Handles MemoryTier (async DMA + LRU touch), BlockDevice (promote_and_serve), Staging (sync DMA). Uses warm_stream for async path.

requirements.title: Lookup Cache Miss
requirements.detail: Returns DispatcherError::KeyNotFound when LookupResult::NotExist.

requirements.title: check(key)
requirements.detail: Queries dispatch map, returns boolean without data transfer.

requirements.title: remove(key)
requirements.detail: Frees memory-tier slot, removes dispatch-map entry, frees SSD extent if BlockDevice.

requirements.title: define_component! Usage
requirements.detail: Uses define_component! macro, exposes only IDispatcher interface.

requirements.title: Receptacles
requirements.detail: Declares ILogger, IDispatchMap, IGpuServices, ISPDKEnv, IMemoryTier receptacles.

requirements.title: initialize Validation
requirements.detail: Validates dispatch_map and memory_tier are bound before proceeding. spdk_env checked conditionally.

requirements.title: Thread Safety
requirements.detail: Dispatch map via Arc with read/write ref semantics. Internal state protected by Mutex.

requirements.title: shutdown Drains Background Operations
requirements.detail: Stops evictor, drains background writer, shuts down block devices in reverse order.

requirements.title: N Block Devices with N Extent Managers
requirements.detail: create_data_drives creates one DataDrive per PCI address with paired block device and extent manager.

requirements.title: FormatParams from Device Size
requirements.detail: Computes data_disk_size, region_size, slab_size, max_extent_size from block device metadata.

requirements.title: Silent Write-Through Failure
requirements.detail: process_write_job silently returns on extent allocation or I/O failure.

requirements.title: remove Does Not Block on Write-Through
requirements.detail: remove() proceeds immediately without waiting for write-through.

requirements.title: MDTS-Aware I/O Segmentation
requirements.detail: io_segmenter splits I/O at MDTS boundaries. Zero-copy pipeline uses 16 concurrent NVMe reads. Fallback ring uses 8 buffers.

requirements.title: prepare_store
requirements.detail: Validates size > 0, rejects duplicates, reserves extent, returns DMA buffer. Cleans up on failure.

requirements.title: commit_store
requirements.detail: Writes buffer to SSD with MDTS segmentation, publishes extent, transitions dispatch-map entry.

requirements.title: cancel_store
requirements.detail: Drops pending write (abort via WriteHandle destructor), removes dispatch-map entry.

requirements.title: touch(key)
requirements.detail: Calls dm.touch(key), returns KeyNotFound if absent. No DMA, no reference acquisition.

requirements.title: Capacity-Based Eviction
requirements.detail: Purely capacity-based: loops while used + needed > capacity, evicts LRU via mt.evict_lru.

requirements.title: format_on_init Flag
requirements.detail: Config field defaults true. When false, iem.format() is skipped.

requirements.title: BlockDeviceVersion Selection
requirements.detail: No block_device_version field in DispatcherConfig. Implementation hardcodes a single block device component.

requirements.title: ExtentManagerVersion Selection
requirements.detail: No extent_manager_version field in DispatcherConfig. Implementation hardcodes a single extent manager.

requirements.title: Promotion Re-Registers as MemoryTier
requirements.detail: promote_and_serve removes old entry, creates fresh MemoryTier entry, preserves ssd_offset.

requirements.title: Background SSD Evictor Thread
requirements.detail: Started during initialize when threshold > 0.0 and drives exist. Joined during shutdown.

requirements.title: SSD Utilization Monitoring
requirements.detail: compute_utilization sums used_bytes/capacity_bytes across extent managers. Interval configurable.

requirements.title: SSD Eviction Logic
requirements.detail: Evicts oldest BlockDevice entries until below low_watermark or batch exhausted.

requirements.title: SSD Evictor Skips MemoryTier
requirements.detail: get_evictable_offset returns None for MemoryTier entries. Failed dm.remove handled gracefully.

requirements.title: SSD Eviction Config Fields
requirements.detail: All four config fields present with correct defaults. Threshold 0.0 disables evictor.

requirements.title: Memory-Tier Pool Registration
requirements.detail: Calls gpu.register_host_memory on pool during init. Non-fatal on failure. Caches ClientChannels per drive.

requirements.title: Memory-Tier Pool Unregistration
requirements.detail: Calls gpu.unregister_host_memory during shutdown before teardown.

success_criteria.detail: Tested via populate + lookup integration tests.
touch called implicitly in lookup MemoryTier path via mt.touch(key).
Pipeline functions tested via hardware integration tests.

unspecced_code.description: Async variant of lookup that returns a GpuStream for non-blocking H2D DMA. Synchronous lookup delegates to it internally. Performance optimization not covered by spec.

drift_details.description: Interface includes lookup_async method not listed in spec FR-001.
drift_details.recommendation: Add lookup_async to spec FR-001 or create FR-036.

drift_details.description: No BlockDeviceVersion field in DispatcherConfig. Single block device implementation hardcoded.
drift_details.recommendation: Add config field and selection logic, or remove FR-026 if only V2 is supported.

drift_details.description: No ExtentManagerVersion field in DispatcherConfig. Single extent manager hardcoded.
drift_details.recommendation: Add config field and selection logic, or remove FR-027 if only one version is supported.

drift_details.description: initialize() rejects empty data_pci_addrs before checking spdk_env connectivity. Memory-tier-only mode requires dummy PCI addresses.
drift_details.recommendation: Move empty PCI address check inside spdk_env.is_connected() block to properly support memory-tier-only mode.
